name: collector-pipeline-health
description: OTel gateway self-telemetry: throughput, drops, exporter health, process usage, error logs, and retained error spans (Catalog B7).

header.content:
# 🛡️ Collector Pipeline Health

The OTel gateway observing itself (`otelcol_*` metrics, internal logs, loopback-tail-sampled internal traces). If the pipeline drops, refuses, or fails to export, it shows here — before anyone trusts an incomplete signal. Built in Catalog B7; deployed with `dtctl`.

throughput.title: Throughput — accepted vs refused (spans)
throughput.query: timeseries { accepted = sum(otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans), refused = sum(otelcol_receiver_refused_spans) }, from: now() - 1h

drops.title: Processor drops (spans + metric points)
drops.query: timeseries { dropped_spans = sum(otelcol_processor_dropped_spans), dropped_points = sum(otelcol_processor_dropped_metric_points) }, by: { processor }, from: now() - 1h

exporter_failures.title: Exporter send failures
exporter_failures.query: timeseries failed = sum(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans), by: { exporter }, from: now() - 1h

queue_depth.title: Exporter queue — size vs capacity
queue_depth.query: timeseries { size = avg(otelcol_exporter_queue_size), capacity = avg(otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity) }, by: { exporter }, from: now() - 1h

error_logs.title: Collector ERROR logs (count / min)
error_logs.query: fetch logs, from: now() - 1h | filter matchesPhrase(k8s.namespace.name, "observability") | filter loglevel == "ERROR" | summarize count(), by: { bin(timestamp, 1m) }

retained_error_spans.title: Retained error spans (tail-sampled)
retained_error_spans.query: fetch spans, from: now() - 1h | filter matchesPhrase(k8s.namespace.name, "observability") | summarize kept = count(), by: { request.status }
